name: owner-queue
description: A live pane of the decisions and hands-on actions waiting on the owner, read from the main checkout's .claude/memory/NEEDS-OWNER.md and from any other project's queue the owner lists; a decision is answered by pressing one of its options, or by typing an answer, and Submit; a typed comment is staged the same way and written as a Note line on Submit

queues.title: Other queues
queues.description: Absolute path of each other project's NEEDS-OWNER.md to show in the pane, beside this project's own. Only the owner sets this list.
